summary: Separate English, French, and Arabic discovery identified Algeria's first-party DGDN/Ministry of Finance Fada El Djazair portal and local Sétif evidence for the El Eulma land registry. Direct anonymous requests to candidate official hosts timed out or returned 403/503, so no safe parcel identity-plus-geometry response was qualified and no GeoJSON sample is retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, routes, statuses, custodian findings, and limitations are recorded in city-4866-el-eulma.json.
